question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

He was __on cloud nine__ when he got admission in Cambridge University.

options.text: available to be called to go to work

solution:
The correct answer is: **very happy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom **"on cloud nine"** means being extremely happy or elated. (बहुत खुश होना)

 
 
• **Example: **She was on cloud nine after winning the lottery.
 
 
 
• **"Very happy"** refers to a state of intense joy or contentment. (बहुत खुश)
 
 
• **Example: **He was very happy when he heard the good news.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **very happy**.
